This biography fits Stefanida's position better than those of other known Ivan Yurlovs, but there is no direct document stating «Стефанида — первая жена Ивана Большого» ["Stefanida is the first wife of Ivan the Elder"].
strings.Почему он вышел на первое место: Why he moved to first place
strings.Совпадает не одно имя, а четыре независи: What coincides is not one name but four independent features: Ivan belonged to a rare branch of the Yurlovs; his first wife remained precisely in the Muscovite state; he died before Stefanida appears in the book; Matison considers the Tver Ivan to be a former holder who lived before 1539. Ivan the Younger (Menshoi) matches in name and generation, but for him there is as yet no family biography this precise. Therefore the Elder is the leading, though still unproven, candidate.
strings.10 февраля и 4 июня 1511 года, а затем в: On 10 February and 4 June 1511, and then in late summer – early autumn 1512, diplomatic documents mentioned the wife of Ivan Yurlov who remained with Vasily III. Her personal name and origin are not given. It is precisely this gap that leaves open the possibility that the woman was Stefanida, but it does not allow the unknown name to be replaced by a confident identification.
strings.Почему Ганна не опровергает Стефаниду: Why Hanna does not refute Stefanida
strings.Ганна, дочь Мартина Богдановича Хребтови: Hanna, daughter of Martin Bogdanovich Khrebtovich, was Ivan's second wife in the Grand Duchy of Lithuania. Kazakov states directly that Ivan married a second time there because his first wife had not been released from the Muscovite state. Consequently, the two female names do not necessarily refer to one woman: Hanna is documented in Lithuania, while the possible Stefanida belongs to the part of the family and property that remained in Muscovy.
strings.Узкое окно смерти: A narrow window for his death
strings.30 января 1529 года Иван записал Ганне 1: On 30 January 1529 Ivan settled 1000 kopas of groschen on Hanna, secured on Samogitian estates — this is the last mention of him while alive. In 1532 Hanna had already sold a house in Vilna, described as her husband's reward for service. Thus Ivan died between these dates. This interval falls entirely before 1539, when Stefanida is recorded as holder of Nikolskoye Svechino.
strings.Что могло остаться за первой женой: What could have remained with the first wife
strings.Статья Казакова не перечисляет московски: Kazakov's article does not list the first wife's Muscovite lands and does not say whether they were her dowry, a widow's maintenance holding, or part of her husband's property. Therefore Nikolskoye Svechino cannot yet be declared a pomestye of Ivan the Elder. But the situation itself — an émigré husband in Lithuania, a wife not released from Moscow who then holds a Russian complex after his death — explains the entry about Stefanida far more concretely than the earlier general conjecture.
strings.30 декабря 1540 года был сделан поминаль: On 30 December 1540 a memorial donation was made for Pyotr Ivanov syn Yurlov. Veselovsky considered Pyotr the son of either Ivan the Elder or Ivan the Younger. If the father proves to be the Elder, Pyotr could have belonged either to the first, Muscovite family or to the second, Lithuanian one; the source does not name the mother. Therefore Pyotr remains an additional link for the synodikon, but does not yet prove kinship with Stefanida.
strings.Что нужно для окончательного доказательс: What is needed for final proof
strings.Решающим станет документ, где рядом появ: The decisive evidence will be a document in which at least two elements appear together: the personal name Stefanida and Ivan Timofeyevich the Elder; Nikolskoye Svechino and the émigré's Muscovite wife; or a list of the Russian holdings left after Ivan's flight. The most promising are the ambassadorial materials of 1511–1512, a patrimonial or maintenance charter of the first wife, and acts concerning the confiscation or preservation of the fugitive's property.
strings.Связь с поиском Онфилога: Connection with the search for Onfilog
strings.Установление мужа Стефаниды не назовёт э: Identifying Stefanida's husband will not automatically name the eponym, but it will narrow down the generation of holders under whom early peasant and land records should be sought. If the complex belonged to Ivan the Elder or his first wife before his flight, Onfilog should be sought among the people of their Muscovite holding of the late 15th – very beginning of the 16th century, rather than among the later Tver Yurlovs.
strings.позднейший держатель пустоши Анфилогово,: later holder of the waste land Anfilogovo, also called Beloglazovo
strings.Никита Старков (современная форма имени): Nikita Starkov (modern form of the name)
strings.В официальной описи д. 16081 после 1634/: In the official inventory of d. 16081, after 1634/1635, entry No. 272 for Yuryevsky stan for the first time names a specific later holder of the place: Mikita Starkov. His pomestye included the waste land Anfilogovo with the second name Beloglazovo. He could not have given the village its name: Onfilogovo already existed in 1539/1540, about a century earlier.
strings.Микита Старков — первый найденный по име: Mikita Starkov is the first person found by name to whom Anfilogovo itself belonged after Stefanida. He is not a hypothetical figure reconstructed from a toponym, but the literal name of a holder in an official archival inventory. The entry stands in the section of vacant lands of Yuryevsky stan and therefore belongs to the same administrative district as the 1539/1540 record.
strings.Статья № 272 читается: «поместье Микиты: Entry No. 272 reads: «поместье Микиты Старкова, пустошь Анфилогово, Белоглазово тож» ["the pomestye of Mikita Starkov, the waste land Anfilogovo, also called Beloglazovo"]. The word «поместье» ["pomestye"] denotes a service land holding; the genitive forms «Микиты Старкова» ["of Mikita Starkov"] answer the question of whose pomestye it is. «Тож» means «то же» ["the same"], that is, Beloglazovo is a second name of one waste land, not a neighbouring village.
strings.Микита — нормальная для старорусских док: Mikita is the normal form in Old Russian documents of the calendar name Nikita. Rendering the man as Nikita is acceptable in a modern retelling, but the literal form Mikita must be preserved: it characterises the language of the source and is not a scribal error.
strings.Что означает фамильное имя Старков: What the family name Starkov means
strings.Старков — родовое именование на -ов, ист: Starkov is a family designation in -ov, historically formed from the personal stem Starko or the nickname stem Stark-. In this entry it already functions as the holder's family name. The meaning of the stem itself tells us nothing about Mikita's age or the origin of the waste land and does not connect him with the eponym Onfilog.
strings.Почему он не основатель: Why he is not the founder
strings.Микита появляется в источнике после 1634: Mikita appears in the source after 1634/1635, whereas Onfilogovo already had four households in 1539/1540. At least 95 years lie between the records. By Mikita's time the name had long existed, and the settlement had already turned into a waste land; therefore Starkov is a later holder, not the man who gave the village its name.
strings.Пустошь — земля прежнего поселения, в ко: A pustosh (waste land) is the land of a former settlement in which, at the time of the survey, no inhabited peasant households were recorded. It is not necessarily a deserted wilderness and not necessarily permanently abandoned land: the arable, meadows and woodland could continue to be used. For Onfilogovo the term shows the break between the four households of the 16th century and the state after the Time of Troubles.
strings.Решающим является не одно название. В то: The name alone is not decisive. In the same small section of Yuryevsky stan, the neighbouring entries name Nikolskoye Svechino, Sadykovo, Ishkovo, Voronino and Popovo — five settlements from Stefanida's single holding of 1539/1540. Such an ownership cluster rules out transferring a random homonymous Anfilogovo from another part of Tver uyezd.
strings.Формула «Анфилогово, Белоглазово тож» вп: The formula «Анфилогово, Белоглазово тож» ["Anfilogovo, also called Beloglazovo"] for the first time reveals the subsequent fate of the name. The old name Anfilogovo was still remembered, but Beloglazovo was used in parallel. The existing village of Beloglazovo lies in the right area, only 2.42 km from the scholarly point for Nikolskoye Svechino; it therefore becomes the most precise modern location of the former Onfilogovo.
strings.Связан ли он с ранними тверскими Старков: Is he connected with the early Tver Starkovs
strings.Теперь связь стала конкретнее. Непосредс: The connection has now become more concrete. Immediately before Mikita's entry stands entry No. 271 on the pomestye of Tretyak Starkov. The service list of 1585 independently names Tretyak Ivanov syn Starkov of Tver and, a few lines above, Kolmak Ivanov syn Starkov. This is no longer a general background of namesakes but two generations of one local service family around adjacent entries. However, Mikita's patronymic is still unknown, so the degree of kinship has not been established.
strings.Кем мог быть Микита в семье Старковых: Who Mikita might have been in the Starkov family
strings.Хронология допускает несколько вариантов: The chronology allows several possibilities. He could have been a younger brother of Kolmak and Tretyak, likewise a son of Ivan Starkov, but not yet holding his own allotment in 1585; he could have been a son of one of the brothers and a member of the next generation; he could have belonged to another branch of the Tver Starkovs. The adjacency of entries No. 271 and 272 strengthens the first or second version but does not choose between them. Only the full name formula in the scribal entry will settle the question.
strings.Почему соседство статей важно: Why the adjacency of the entries matters
strings.Опись последовательно ставит «поместье Т: The inventory places «поместье Третьяка Старкова» ["the pomestye of Tretyak Starkov"] and «поместье Микиты Старкова» ["the pomestye of Mikita Starkov"] one after the other. Archival registers often group related land entries, and here the rare family designation also coincides. This is a serious reason to order both entries together: Tretyak's entry may contain a formula of division, inheritance or joint grant explaining Mikita's appearance at Anfilogovo. But the adjacency of lines by itself is not a record of kinship.
strings.Где искать полный текст: Where to look for the full text
strings.По двум независимым якорям внутри дела с: Based on two independent anchors within the file, entry No. 272 should be located approximately around l. 281. The safe archival range is ll. 279–283: it should capture Tretyak's entry No. 271, Mikita's entry No. 272 and their versos. The folio number is so far calculated; it must not be cited as definitively verified until a copy is obtained.
strings.Полная писцовая статья д. 16081 может на: The full scribal entry of d. 16081 may name Mikita's patronymic, the previous holder, the basis of the grant, the size of the land and the boundary neighbours. Especially important would be a reference to an old charter of installation, allotment or grant: such a charter could extend the chain back from Starkov to the Yurlovs and, possibly, to the eponym's generation.
strings.боярин и князь, в вотчине которого Белог: boyar and prince in whose votchina Beloglazovo is documented in 1677
strings.В переписной книге 1677—1678 годов Белог: In the census book of 1677–1678 Beloglazovo forms part of the extensive votchina of boyar Prince Grigory Semyonovich Kurakin. He is the next holder of our place found after Mikita Starkov; he is not connected with the origin of the name Onfilogovo.
strings.Белоглазово больше не исчезает после кра: Beloglazovo no longer disappears after Mikita Starkov's brief entry. A. V. Matison's reference work directly includes the village in the votchina of Prince Grigory Semyonovich Kurakin under the year 1677. The result is a documented sequence for the place: Onfilogovo held by Stefanida in 1539/1540 → the waste land Anfilogovo, also called Beloglazovo, held by Mikita Starkov after 1634/1635 → the village of Beloglazovo in Kurakin's votchina in 1677.
strings.Статья справочника даёт полную форму «Ку: The reference entry gives the full form «Куракин Григорий Семенович, князь (1677). Боярин» ["Kurakin Grigory Semenovich, prince (1677). Boyar"]. Grigory is the personal calendar name, Semyonovich the patronymic, Kurakin the family name; prince denotes descent, boyar the highest Duma rank. This is an incomparably higher social status than that of the provincial syn boyarsky Tretyak Starkov.
strings.Белоглазово перечислено не отдельно, а в: Beloglazovo is listed not separately but within a large votchina together with Mikulino-Gorodishche, the priselok to Spaskoye, Oshurkovo, Kolachovo, Korshikovo, Leonovo, Leshchikhino, Glebovo, Koskovo, Gorki, Dorozhayevo, Shepelevo, Yuryevskoye and Gusevo. This shows an already different 17th-century ownership complex; by that time the ancient holding of Nikolskoye Svechino had been broken up and regrouped.
strings.Связь устанавливает не фамилия Куракин,: The connection is established not by the surname Kurakin but by the already proven chain of names: entry No. 272 after 1634/1635 names one place «Анфилогово, Белоглазово тож» ["Anfilogovo, also called Beloglazovo"], and modern Beloglazovo lies next to Nikolskoye Svechino and the rest of the stable cluster. The 1677 record continues the later name of this place; the other Onfilogovo had the second name Chagrimovo and a different ownership history.
strings.Почему Куракин не эпоним: Why Kurakin is not the eponym
strings.Деревня называлась Онфилоговом уже в 153: The village was called Onfilogovo already in 1539/1540, more than 137 years before Kurakin's census. The prince could have owned the place when the name Beloglazovo was in use, but could not have given it the old name Onfilogovo. His role is that of a later votchina owner and an important bridge to the 17th-century population.
strings.У Микиты Старкова место обозначено как п: Under Mikita Starkov the place is designated a pomestye — a conditional service holding; under Kurakin Beloglazovo is part of a votchina — a hereditary land holding. The transition itself from one category to the other has not yet been traced: it is unknown whether the place was granted to Kurakin, purchased, inherited, or entered the large complex by some other route.
strings.Матисон ссылается на переписную книгу Тв: Matison refers to the census book of Tver and Tver uyezd of 1677–1678: RGADA, f. 1209, op. 1, d. 16060, ll. 319 verso–348. An additional reference leads to the census of 1710: d. 16086, ll. 320, 348. The full text can now be ordered within a narrow range, rather than searching for Beloglazovo through the whole file.
strings.Что может дать полный текст: What the full text may yield
strings.Переписная статья способна перечислить к: The census entry may list the peasant households and the male population of Beloglazovo, indicate whether it was an empty village or a newly resettled one, and name the steward and the composition of the neighbouring complex. These names will no longer lead directly to the 15th-century founder, but they will show when the waste land became a village again and how the old name was preserved among the inhabitants.
strings.А. В. Матисон. «Дворянство Тверского уез: A. V. Matison. «Дворянство Тверского уезда XVI — начала XVIII веков: справочник» [The Nobility of Tver Uyezd, 16th – Early 18th Centuries: A Reference Book]. Moscow: Drevlekhranilishche, 2023. P. 144, note 3. Basis of the entry: RGADA, f. 1209, op. 1, d. 16060, ll. 319 verso–348; d. 16086, ll. 320, 348.
strings.владелец и продавец комплекса, в котором: owner and seller of the complex in which the village of Beloglazova on the Rzhat is named in 1655
Prince Ivan Andreyevich Golitsyn sold ... the village (selo) of Oshurkovo with its villages and waste lands
strings.Непосредственный предшественник Григория: The immediate predecessor of Grigory Kurakin in the large Mikulino-Oshurkovo complex. In the transfer book of 21 August 1655, among the settlements he sold, the inhabited village of Beloglazova on the river Rzhat is named — the modern continuation of Onfilogovo. Golitsyn is neither the founder nor the eponym.
strings.Отказная книга 21 августа 1655 года впер: The transfer book of 21 August 1655 for the first time places Beloglazovo on a precise river: «деревня Белоглазова на реке на Ржати» ["the village of Beloglazova on the river Rzhat"]. Modern Beloglazovo does indeed lie on the Rzhat. This is independent documentary confirmation of the map and a bridge between Mikita Starkov's waste land after 1634/1635 and Grigory Kurakin's votchina of 1677.
strings.Иван — личное календарное имя; Андреевич: Ivan is the personal calendar name; Andreyevich the patronymic, literally son of Andrei; Golitsyn the princely family name. What matters in the source is not the meaning of the surname but the man's legal role: he sells a large land complex, after which it is officially transferred to the new owner.
strings.Голицын продал князю Григорию Семёновичу: Golitsyn sold to Prince Grigory Semyonovich Kurakin Mikulino, Oshurkovo and the dependent villages and waste lands. On 21 August 1655 the authorities formalised the transfer — the «отказ» ["otkaz", transfer]. The list of villages includes the Beloglazova on the Rzhat that concerns us; hence it belonged to the sold complex immediately before passing to Kurakin.
strings.Река устраняет главную географическую не: The river removes the main geographical uncertainty. After 1634/1635 our place is named «Анфилогово, Белоглазово тож» ["Anfilogovo, also called Beloglazovo"]; modern Beloglazovo stands on the Rzhat; a plan of the General Survey later shows «д. Онфилогова» ["the village of Onfilogova"] next to Voronina. The old and the second names, the river and the stable neighbourhood all coincide.
strings.Из пустоши снова в деревню: From waste land back to village
strings.У Микиты Старкова после 1634/1635 года о: Under Mikita Starkov after 1634/1635 the place was a waste land — the site of a former settlement without a functioning village. In the act of 1655 it is already called a village. Consequently, restoration or resettlement occurred between these dates. The published list does not give the names of the new inhabitants.
strings.Позднее в том же перечне пустошей отдель: Later in the same list of waste lands there is, separately, another «пустошь Белоглазова» ["waste land Beloglazova"]. This is a different object of the same name. Only «деревня Белоглазова на реке на Ржати» ["the village of Beloglazova on the river Rzhat"] corresponds to our chain; confusing the two Beloglazovos would distort both the map and the ownership history.
strings.Микулинская летопись рассказывает, что Г: The Mikulino Chronicle relates that Golitsyn and his wife Feodosiya Andreyevna bought back the old votchina of the Princes Mikulinsky from the Kirillov Monastery. But from the published sequence it cannot be proven that Beloglazova on the Rzhat in particular was part of the earlier monastic portion. The passing of the village itself from Mikita Starkov to Golitsyn remains a gap in the chain.
strings.Почему Голицын не основатель: Why Golitsyn is not the founder
strings.Название Онфилогово существовало уже в 1: The name Onfilogovo already existed in 1539/1540, 115 years before the transaction. Golitsyn is a later owner of an already renamed and resettled village; his act helps locate the place and trace ownership, but does not give the name of the first settler of the 15th – early 16th century.
strings.«Микулинская летопись, составленная по д: «Микулинская летопись, составленная по древним актам от 1354 до 1678 года» [The Mikulino Chronicle, Compiled from Ancient Acts from 1354 to 1678]. Tver, 1911. Account of the sale and the transfer record: printed pp. 72–75, digital PDF pages 73–76. Electronic copy of the Tver Regional Universal Scientific Library: https://docs.tverlib.ru/kraevedenie/mikulinskaja_letopis.pdf .
strings.владелец другого тверского Онфилогова, н: owner of another Onfilogovo in Tver uyezd, which bore the second name Chagrimovo
strings.Помещик 1588 года, владевший другим Онфи: A pomeshchik (service landholder) of 1588 who held another Onfilogovo — «Чагримово тож» ["also called Chagrimovo"]. He is not part of the history of Beloglazovo; his file has been added as a safeguard against confusing homonymous settlements and owners.
strings.Почему он появился в карточке: Why he appears in the card
strings.В Тверском уезде существовало как миниму: There were at least two Onfilogovos in Tver uyezd. Under Likharev in 1588 «Онфилогово Чагримово тож» ["Onfilogovo, also called Chagrimovo"] is recorded; our settlement after 1634/1635 is called «Анфилогово, Белоглазово тож» ["Anfilogovo, also called Beloglazovo"]. Without the second name the documents are easily confused, so Likharev matters above all as a negative identifier.
strings.Что известно о владельце: What is known about the owner
strings.Степан Афанасьевич Лихарев получил помес: Stepan Afanasyevich Likharev received a service allotment of 200 chetverts. In 1588 Volkovo, Onfilogovo also called Chagrimovo, Borikhino also called Martyanovo, Padaltsovo, Osanovo also called Volotskoye, and a waste land are listed under him; the holding was separated off in the same year.
strings.Как различать две деревни: How to distinguish the two villages
strings.Для Онфилогова Лихарева обязательный яко: For Likharev's Onfilogovo the obligatory anchor is the second name Chagrimovo and the neighbouring set Volkovo, Borikhino, Padaltsovo, Osanovo. For our Onfilogovo, Beloglazovo and the cluster Nikolskoye Svechino, Sadykovo, Ishkovo, Voronino, Popovo are obligatory. A coincidence of the single word Onfilogovo is not enough.
strings.Статья № 161 отказной книги 1667/1668 го: Entry No. 161 of the transfer book of 1667/1668, RGADA, f. 1209, op. 1, pt. 2, d. 16065, on magnification reads «Анфилогово, Чагримово тож» ["Anfilogovo, also called Chagrimovo"]. It continues Likharev's line of ownership and must be excluded from the Beloglazovo chain.
strings.А. В. Матисон. «Дворянство Тверского уез: A. V. Matison. «Дворянство Тверского уезда XVI — начала XVIII веков» [The Nobility of Tver Uyezd, 16th – Early 18th Centuries]. P. 151, note 13; original publication: «Писцовые материалы Тверского уезда XVI века» [Scribal Materials of Tver Uyezd of the 16th Century], Moscow, 2005, pp. 564–565.
strings.держатель соседнего поместья Старковых;: holder of the neighbouring Starkov pomestye; probably the Tver serviceman from the 1585 list
strings.статья № 271: поместье Третьяка Старкова: entry No. 271: the pomestye of Tretyak Starkov
strings.Статья № 271 официальной описи д. 16081: Entry No. 271 of the official inventory of d. 16081 immediately precedes Mikita Starkov's entry on Anfilogovo. The Tver service list of 1585 gives the full form of the name: Tretyak Ivanov syn Starkov. The identity is highly probable given the rare name, the family designation, the uyezd and the period, but it must be confirmed by the full text of the entry.
strings.Главная ценность имени: The main value of the name
strings.Третьяк Старков — ближайший персональный: Tretyak Starkov is Mikita's closest personal neighbour not on a modern map but in the archival register itself: his pomestye is recorded as entry No. 271, and Mikita's Anfilogovo as the next entry, No. 272. For the first time this turns Mikita from an isolated name into a member of a specific Tver family circle.
strings.Отписка Симеона Бекбулатовича от 4 июня: A report of Simeon Bekbulatovich of 4 June 1585 calls him «Третьяк Иванов сын Старков» ["Tretyak, Ivan's son, Starkov"]. The name is Tretyak, the patronymic part is Ivanov syn, the family designation is Starkov. Unlike the brief 17th-century inventory, this source directly gives the father's name: Ivan Starkov.
strings.Смысл имени Третьяк: The meaning of the name Tretyak
strings.Третьяк — некалендарное русское имя, обы: Tretyak is a non-calendar Russian name, usually denoting the third child or third son in a family. It is not a modern patronymic and does not mean the surname Tretyakov. In the source the man bears both the everyday name Tretyak and the family designation Starkov.
strings.В списке 1585 года Третьяк помещён среди: In the 1585 list Tretyak is placed among the Tver provincial deti boyarskie with an allotment of 150 chetverts and a cash salary of 8 roubles. This shows him as a minor service landholder bound to state service, not as a village peasant.
strings.Тот ли это человек из статьи № 271: Is this the man of entry No. 271
strings.Совпадают редкое личное имя Третьяк, род: The rare personal name Tretyak, the family designation Starkov, Tver uyezd and a suitable time interval all coincide. The identity is therefore highly probable. But the inventory of entry No. 271 does not give the patronymic, and about forty years separate the documents; formally a younger relative of the same name is also possible.
strings.Микита мог быть братом Третьяка, его сын: Mikita could have been Tretyak's brother, his son, or a member of another branch of the Starkovs. If the full text calls Mikita Ivanov syn (son of Ivan), brotherhood is more likely; if Tretyakov syn (son of Tretyak), a direct father–son relationship. For now these forms are verification criteria, not supplemented parts of the name.
strings.Третьяк жил и служил значительно позже в: Tretyak lived and served considerably later than the emergence of the name Onfilogovo. He is important for the transfer of the land to the Starkovs and for the search for old charters, but cannot be the man who gave the settlement its name: the village is already documented in 1539/1540.
strings.Нужно получить статью № 271 полностью вм: Entry No. 271 must be obtained in full together with entry No. 272. Especially important are the patronymic, the basis of the grant, the previous holder and any words such as «по отцу» ["after the father"], «братья» ["brothers"], «жеребей» ["share"], «дано» ["granted"] or a reference to a charter. It is precisely such a formula that can prove the kinship of Tretyak and Mikita.
strings.тверской сын боярский 1585 года; вероятн: Tver syn boyarsky of 1585; probable brother of Tretyak Starkov
strings.Служилый список 1585 года называет Колма: The service list of 1585 names Kolmak and Tretyak as Ivanov children Starkov (sons of Ivan Starkov) in the same Tver part of the list. The coincidence of father and family designation makes brotherhood probable, although the document does not use the direct formula «братья» ["brothers"]. Kolmak's land has not yet been connected with Anfilogovo.
strings.Почему Колмак появился в досье: Why Kolmak appears in the file
strings.Он даёт вторую опору для реконструкции с: He provides a second support for reconstructing the family. Tretyak turns out to have a man with the same father Ivan and the same designation Starkov in the same service list. This allows us to speak not of a single chance namesake but of a Tver family circle of Starkovs at the end of the 16th century.
strings.Колмак — личное некалендарное имя или пр: Kolmak is a personal non-calendar name or nickname; Ivanov syn indicates the father Ivan; Starkov is the family designation. The modern short rendering «Колмак Старков» ["Kolmak Starkov"] loses the patronymic, so the full documentary form is kept in the heading.
strings.Смысл имени Колмак: The meaning of the name Kolmak
strings.Имя Колмак обычно сопоставляют с историч: The name Kolmak is usually compared with the historical form of the ethnonym «калмак/калмык» ["Kalmak/Kalmyk"], but for a specific person this does not prove ethnic origin. Scholarly onomastics shows the wide use of such a name among Russian servicemen of the 16th century; it must not be turned into a ready-made biographical characteristic.
strings.Его место в служилом списке: His place in the service list
strings.Колмак записан среди тверских городовых: Kolmak is recorded among the Tver town deti boyarskie with an allotment of 250 chetverts and 10 rubles — higher than Tretyak, who received 150 chetverts and 8 rubles. The difference in allotments may reflect seniority, service or the size of the pomestye, but by itself it does not prove that Kolmak was the elder brother.
strings.Оба названы Ивановыми сыновьями Старковы: Both are called Ivanov's sons Starkov and stand in the same Tver list of the same year. For such a rare combination this is a strong sign of a common father. Researchers also regard them as possible brothers, but a direct kinship formula has not yet been found.
strings.Если Микита принадлежал следующему покол: If Mikita belonged to the next generation, Kolmak is a possible father or uncle; if Mikita was a younger son of Ivan, he could have been the brother of both. Neither version yet has a direct record. Kolmak's value lies in creating a testable set of possible patronymics and kinship forms for reading article No. 272.
strings.Чего находка не доказывает: What the find does not prove
strings.Она не связывает Колмака с Анфилоговом,: It does not link Kolmak with Anfilogovo, does not make the Starkovs owners of the village in 1539, and does not bring them close enough in time to the eponym himself to declare them founders. This is a later line of owners that may lead to older acts.
strings.монастырский крестьянин непашенного двор: monastery peasant of a non-ploughing household; bearer of the patronymic designation Onfilogov
strings.В 1536/1537 году записан среди непашенны: In 1536/1537 he is recorded among the non-ploughing households of the village (selo) of Priluk — a votchina of the Trinity-Sergius Monastery in the Town stan of Uglich uyezd. The designation Onfilogov points to an older man named Onfilog, most likely his father. This is the closest personal trace in terms of generation, but a connection of the family with Tver Onfilogovo has not been proven.
strings.Публикация писцовой выписи 1536/1537 год: The publication of the scribal extract of 1536/1537 first names «Село Прилук на реке на Волге» ["the village of Priluk on the river Volga"], then lists the peasants and, separately, the non-ploughing households. In this second rubric stands the exact formula: «в. Тонкой Онфилогов» ["in the household: Tonkoi Onfilogov"]. This is a direct documentary name, not a reconstruction from a modern reference work.
strings.Тонкой записан внутри крестьянского насе: Tonkoi is recorded within the peasant population of the votchina of the Trinity-Sergius Monastery. Therefore the most accurate designation is a monastery peasant of a non-ploughing household. The source does not call him a landholder (pomeshchik), a syn boyarsky or the owner of Priluk.
strings.Непашенный двор не нёс обычного пашенног: A non-ploughing household did not carry ordinary arable farming as part of the monastery's sokha. The reason could be a craft, a trade, service at the village or some other non-agricultural occupation, but the document does not state Tonkoi's profession. Therefore the card does not turn him into a fisherman, craftsman or servant without a separate record.
strings.Какой работой он мог заниматься: What work he may have done
strings.Прилук был крупным монастырским промысло: Priluk was a large monastery trading and fishing settlement on the Volga: 15th-century acts mention the Priluk fishermen, Volga fishing grounds, boats and the transport of grain through the Tver principality. Therefore fishing, river trades, commerce, craft or service in the monastery economy are plausible for the inhabitant of a non-ploughing household. But the line of 1536/1537 does not state Tonkoi's occupation, and the most attractive version, that he was a fisherman, remains only a contextual hypothesis.
strings.Редактор раскрывает повторяющееся «в.» к: The editor expands the repeated «в.» as «во дворе» ["in the household"]. It marks a separate household, not a military rank and not an abbreviation of a name. In the closing line of the whole Priluk complex, 21 non-ploughing households and 21 persons recorded in them are counted; Tonkoi is one of these enumerated men.
strings.Смысл имени Тонкой: The meaning of the name Tonkoi
strings.Тонкой — мирское имя или прозвище, соотв: Tonkoi is a secular name or nickname corresponding to the modern word «тонкий» ["thin"]. It may have described his build or become fixed as a family designation, but the source does not explain the reason for the nickname. The modern normalisation «Тонкий» (Tonky) is useful for searching, while in quotations the form «Тонкой» (Tonkoi) must be preserved.
strings.В первой половине XVI века форма на -ов: In the first half of the 16th century the form in -ov was often possessive-patronymic: Tonkoi is the son or man of Onfilog. The most natural reconstruction is «Тонкой, Онфилогов сын» ["Tonkoi, Onfilog's son"]. This is not another personal name of Tonkoi and not a proven hereditary surname in the later sense.
strings.Какой Онфилог скрыт в его имени: Which Onfilog is hidden in his name
strings.Именование Тонкого независимо удостоверя: Tonkoi's designation independently attests the existence of an older man named Onfilog. If this is his father, he belonged to the previous generation and could have been an adult at the turn of the 15th–16th centuries — exactly when the name of the Tver village must have arisen. But his patronymic, occupation and place of residence are not directly recorded.
strings.Почему это сильнейший кандидат: Why this is the strongest candidate
strings.Среди всех найденных людей Тонкой ближе: Of all the people found, Tonkoi is the closest to the sought-for eponym in the rarity of the name and in generation: his record is only three years older than the first description of Tver Onfilogovo, and the name points back one more generation. The later Anfilogovs of the 17th century are too young to have founded the village.
strings.Село Прилук находилось в Угличском уезде: The village of Priluk lay in Uglich uyezd, about 208 km in a straight line from Nikolskoye Svechino and Beloglazovo. Now, however, not merely a hypothetical but a documentary route has been found: in 1461–1466 the prince of Tver allowed the peasants and fishermen of the Priluk estate passage through the Tver principality, and a separate charter let boats travel to Priluk and back. The obstacle is no longer the possibility of movement itself, but the absence of the name of Onfilog or Tonkoi in a specific Tver record.
strings.С. М. Каштанов опубликовал запись в стат: S. M. Kashtanov published the record in the article "On the Trail of the Trinity Copy Books of the 16th Century" (Po sledam troitskikh kopiynykh knig XVI v.): Zapiski otdela rukopisei [Notes of the Manuscript Department], issue 40, Moscow, 1979, p. 43. The manuscript reference of the publication is GPB [State Public Library], Pogodin collection, No. 1846, l. 65 verso. This makes it possible to check the reading directly against the copy book.
strings.Какой документ превратит кандидата в осн: What document would turn the candidate into the founder
strings.Нужна запись о Тонком или его отце в Тве: What is needed is a record of Tonkoi or his father in Tver uyezd, of the transfer of their land to the Yurlovs, or an act linking Priluk in Uglich uyezd with Nikolskoye Svechino. Without such a bridge Tonkoi remains the bearer of the name of the most suitable Onfilog, but not a proven son of the founder of the Tver village.
strings.угличский Онфилог предыдущего поколения;: Onfilog of Uglich of the previous generation; the closest personal candidate for the Tver eponym
strings.Онфилог — отец или старший человек Тонко: Onfilog — the father or senior man of Tonkoi
strings.Сам человек не назван отдельной строкой:: The man himself is not named in a separate line: his name is reconstructed from Tonkoi Onfilogov's dependent designation. Most likely he is Tonkoi's father and a man of the generation at the turn of the 15th–16th centuries. By name and time he fits the Tver eponym better than the other candidates, but a geographical link is missing.
strings.Почему это отдельный человек: Why this is a separate person
strings.В формуле «Тонкой Онфилогов» личное имя: In the formula «Тонкой Онфилогов» ["Tonkoi Onfilogov"] the personal name Tonkoi refers to the recorded peasant, while the form Onfilogov preserves the name of another, older man. Therefore they cannot be merged into a single "Tonkoi Onfilog": the source points to at least two personal positions.
strings.Насколько уверенно это отец: How certain it is that he is the father
strings.Патронимическое чтение «Онфилогов сын» д: The patronymic reading «Онфилогов сын» ["Onfilog's son"] is the most natural for the period, so father is the leading version. Theoretically the form could denote dependence on a master, belonging to a household or another type of connection. As long as there is no direct word «сын» ["son"], the card keeps the broader formula "father or senior man".
strings.Тонкой уже имел отдельный двор в 1536/15: Tonkoi already had a separate household in 1536/1537. His father or senior patron must belong to the previous generation: cautiously, the end of the 15th or the very beginning of the 16th century. This is exactly the time layer required for the name of a village already established by 1539/1540.
strings.Тверской топоним восстанавливает основу: The Tver toponym reconstructs the stem Onfilog-, and the Uglich record gives the form Onfilogov without any need to change consonants or the church form. This is a more exact match than the late Anpilogs and Amfilokhys, which are used only as linguistic parallels.
strings.Почему он мог быть крестьянином: Why he could have been a peasant
strings.Его предполагаемый сын Тонкой — монастыр: His presumed son Tonkoi is a monastery peasant, not a serving landholder. This makes the peasant scenario for the origin of the name especially vivid: a village could indeed be called by the name of its first settler or the head of a household. But the father's estate did not necessarily coincide fully with the son's position and is not directly recorded.
strings.Почему он всё ещё не найденный основател: Why he is still not the found founder
strings.Документ удостоверяет угличского Онфилог: The document attests the Uglich Onfilog through Tonkoi's name, and the place name attests the Tver Onfilog through the toponym. No source yet says that they are the same person. Fifteenth-century acts already prove the movement of Priluk peasants and fishermen through the Tver principality, but they do not name Onfilog among them and do not lead the route to Nikolskoye Svechino. A common corridor has been found; a personal bridge is still missing.
strings.До 1521 года Иван Юрлов Меньшой владел д: Until 1521 Ivan Yurlov Menshoi [the Younger] owned another village, Inkovo, in the same Uglich uyezd. This coincidence creates a possible setting for contact between the Yurlov family and a man named Onfilog. However, Inkovo and Priluk have not been placed in a single boundary system, and Yurlov is not named as owner or neighbour of Tonkoi.
strings.Это наиболее близкий персональный кандид: This is the closest personal candidate, not an established biography of the eponym. High confidence applies to the existence of the name Onfilog and to the suitable generation; medium confidence to his fatherhood in relation to Tonkoi; low confidence to his identity with the man who gave his name to the Tver village.
strings.Проверять нужно ранние акты Юрловых и Тр: What needs to be checked are the early acts of the Yurlovs and of the Trinity-Sergius Monastery, movements of dependent people, Inkovo in Uglich uyezd and the Tver complex of Nikolskoye Svechino. Sufficient proof would be a single record in which Onfilog or Tonkoi is named alongside Tver neighbours, or in which Onfilog's land passes to Ivan Yurlov.
strings.прямой носитель редкого имени Анфилоф ок: a direct bearer of the rare name Anfilof around 1495–1497; a candidate for verification, not an established eponym
strings.Около 1495—1497 годов назван среди шести: Around 1495–1497 he is named among six people present at the court of the Yaroslavl tiun Afanasy Durov in a dispute over the Kresttsy hayfield by the Kotorosl. He is the earliest direct bearer found of a close form of the name in the right generation. A connection with Tver Onfilogovo, Nikolskoye Svechino and the Yurlovs has not been proven.
strings.В конце акта № 208 читается: «А на суде: At the end of act No. 208 one reads: «А на суде были Гордин соцкой, да Григорей Ярцев, да Мита Галасьев, да Лука Максимов, да Клим Давыдов, да Анфилоф Селиванов» ["And present at the court were Gordin the sotsky, and Grigorei Yartsev, and Mita Galasyev, and Luka Maksimov, and Klim Davydov, and Anfilof Selivanov"]. The name has been checked against the facsimile of pages 218–219 of volume III of ASEI, not only against the name indexes.
strings.Правая грамота датирована издателями при: The editors date the court charter (pravaya gramota) approximately to 1495–1497. Anfilof was an adult participant in an official land court about 42–45 years before the first description of Onfilogovo. This is exactly the generation in which a man could have lived who had already left his name to a settlement established by 1539/1540.
strings.Акт относится к Ярославскому уезду и спо: The act relates to Yaroslavl uyezd and the disputed Kresttsy hayfield by the river Kotorosl, associated with the Spaso-Yaroslavsky Monastery. The exact boundary of the hayfield has not been reconstructed; the Yaroslavl marker on the map indicates the event near the monastery, not a proven location of Anfilof's household.
strings.Источник говорит лишь, что он был «на су: The source says only that he was «на суде» ["at the court"]. The name index calls him a «муж» ["man"] at the court of the Yaroslavl tiun, that is, a participant in the judicial procedure or a representative of the local community. He is not named as plaintiff, defendant, judge, owner of the hayfield or scribe.
strings.Почему нельзя назвать его крестьянином: Why he cannot be called a peasant
strings.Социальный статус Анфилофа Селиванова в: Anfilof Selivanov's social status is not stated in the act. He could have been a local serving man, a landholder or a well-to-do peasant suitable for taking part in the proceedings, but none of these versions is recorded directly. In this he differs from Tonkoi Onfilogov, whose place among the monastery households is known exactly.
strings.Смысл двухчастного имени: The meaning of the two-part name
strings.Анфилоф — личное мужское имя. Селиванов: Anfilof is a male personal name. Selivanov is a designation in -ov, naturally understood for the late 15th century as a link to a father or senior man named Selivan: «Анфилоф, Селиванов сын» ["Anfilof, Selivan's son"]. This is not necessarily a hereditary surname in the modern sense.
strings.Анфилоф и Онфилог — одно именное гнездо: Anfilof and Onfilog — one name cluster
strings.Формы Анфилоф, Онфилог и Анфилог передаю: The forms Anfilof, Onfilog and Anfilog render a rare name with the characteristic fluctuation of initial A-/O- and of final consonants. The very presence of Anfilof in a 15th-century act proves that a similar name was used by living people and was not a late fantasy derived from the village name. But the linguistic kinship of the forms does not turn two bearers into one person.
strings.Сравнение двух сильнейших следов: Comparison of the two strongest traces
strings.Анфилоф Селиванов назван лично и раньше: Anfilof Selivanov is named personally and earlier — around 1495–1497. Tonkoi Onfilogov is recorded in 1536/1537, but his designation preserves the stem Onfilog- almost literally and points to an older Onfilog of the previous generation. Anfilof is stronger as a direct person of the right era; the Uglich Onfilog is stronger as an exact match with the toponym.
strings.Анфилоф найден у Которосли в Ярославском: Anfilof was found by the Kotorosl in Yaroslavl uyezd, while the village in question lay at Nikolskoye Svechino in Tver uyezd. The act contains no Yurlovs, no Onfilogovo, no Khorvach volost and no transfer of land. Therefore the rare name and the suitable date give a candidate for verification, but not the right to move the man to Tver.
strings.Что может связать его с деревней: What could link him to the village
strings.Нужен второй документ: владение или служ: A second document is needed: Anfilof's landholding or service in Tver uyezd, his children in the service of the Yurlovs, participation in the transfer of Nikolskoye Svechino, or a charter in which his land is called Onfilogova. So far only the name, the approximate date, the Yaroslavl geography and his presence at the court are firmly proven.
strings.Акты социально-экономической истории Сев: Acts of the Socio-Economic History of North-Eastern Rus' from the Late 14th to the Early 16th Century (Akty sotsialno-ekonomicheskoi istorii Severo-Vostochnoi Rusi kontsa XIV — nachala XVI v.), vol. III. Moscow: Nauka, 1964. Act No. 208, pp. 217–219. Archival reference given in the edition: GKE [State Collection of Economic Charters], Yaroslavl, No. 3/14751.
strings.прежний владелец четверти деревни Титовс: former owner of a quarter of the village of Titovskaya; an independent bearer of the form Anfilofy in 1516
strings.Назван в купчей августа 1516 года как че: Named in a deed of purchase of August 1516 as the man from whom Maksim Nesterov had earlier bought a quarter of the village of Titovskaya. He is a direct bearer of a close form of the name and a former owner of land in the right generation, but the act belongs to the northern Russian complex of the Antoniev-Siysky Monastery and does not link him with Tver.
strings.Что сообщает купчая: What the deed of purchase reports
strings.Максим Нестеров продаёт четверть деревни: Maksim Nesterov sells a quarter of the village of Titovskaya and explains the origin of his right: he had earlier bought this share «у Анфилофья у Иванова сына» ["from Anfilofy, Ivan's son"]. Consequently, Anfilofy was not a casual witness but the previous holder of the alienated part of the village.
strings.«Анфилофья» — родительный падеж личного: «Анфилофья» is the genitive case of the personal name Anfilofy; «Иванова сына» means "son of Ivan". The source gives no hereditary surname. The normalised form is Anfilofy, Ivanov syn (Ivan's son).
strings.Почему он полезен для Онфилогова: Why he is useful for Onfilogovo
strings.Акт датирован августом 1516 года — покол: The act is dated August 1516 — the generation immediately preceding the first record of the Tver village. It proves that a close name was borne by a real person who disposed of land; hence the ownership scenario for the formation of a name in -ovo is historically possible.
strings.Почему он не наш основатель: Why he is not our founder
strings.Деревня Титовская входит в севернорусски: The village of Titovskaya belongs to the northern Russian act complex of the Antoniev-Siysky Monastery. The deed of purchase contains no Tver uyezd, no Nikolskoye Svechino, no Yurlovs and no neighbours of Onfilogovo. The name, the time and the role in landholding coincide, but the decisive geography is missing.
strings.Цифровая публикация акта СПбИИ РАН: «Куп: Digital publication of the act by the St Petersburg Institute of History of the Russian Academy of Sciences (SPbII RAN): «Купчая продажная Максима Нестерова на четверть деревни Титовской» ["Deed of sale of Maksim Nesterov for a quarter of the village of Titovskaya"], August 1516; the archival reference and image are available in the GIS of the History of Writing.
strings.послух купчей 1516 года; второй независи: witness (poslukh) of the 1516 deed of purchase; a second independent bearer of the form Anfilof in a single land transaction
strings.В той же купчей 1516 года назван послухо: In the same 1516 deed of purchase he is named as a witness (poslukh) together with Mikifor Matfeyev syn. This is a different person, not the former owner Anfilofy Ivanov syn. The simultaneous appearance of two Anfilofs shows that the name was rare but not unique.
strings.Заключительная формула купчей гласит: «А: The closing formula of the deed of purchase reads: «А на то послус Микифор Матфеев сын, да Анфилоф Мосеев сын» ["And witnesses to this: Mikifor, Matfei's son, and Anfilof, Mosei's son"]. Anfilof took part in the legal attestation of the land transaction as a witness (poslukh).
strings.Послух — не обязательно очевидец: A poslukh is not necessarily an eyewitness
strings.В актовой практике послух подтверждал пр: In the practice of acts, a poslukh confirmed the lawfulness of a transaction or could answer for it in case of a dispute. The source does not call Anfilof a peasant, a landholder or a relative of the parties, so his social status cannot be extrapolated from a single formula.
strings.Это патронимическое именование: Анфилоф,: This is a patronymic designation: Anfilof, son of Mosei, that is, of Moisei (Moses). It distinguishes him from Anfilofy Ivanov syn, mentioned earlier in the same deed of purchase, and proves that we are dealing with two people.
strings.Как находка меняет рейтинг: How the find changes the ranking
strings.Наличие двух независимых Анфилофов в одн: The presence of two independent Anfilofs in one act shows that the similar name was not so unique that a single Anfilof Selivanov or the Uglich Onfilog could automatically be recognised as the Tver eponym. Now decisive weight belongs only to a documentary link with the place.
strings.Тот же акт СПбИИ РАН: купчая Максима Нес: The same SPbII RAN act: the deed of purchase of Maksim Nesterov for a quarter of the village of Titovskaya, August 1516. The text, metadata and digital image are published together.
strings.государев крестьянин 1530-х годов; сильн: a sovereign's peasant of the 1530s; the strongest direct parallel for the peasant version of the origin of the name
strings.Назван в рязанской судной грамоте 1530-х: Named in a Ryazan court charter (sudnaya gramota) of the 1530s among the participants of a sovereign's inquest (obysk) into the origin and age of the village of Ruposovo. He is a direct peasant with the full personal form Anfilog in exactly the right era, but his connection with Nikolskoye Svechino in Tver uyezd has not been established.
strings.На л. 212 в перечне участников обыска ст: On l. 212, in the list of participants of the inquest, stands the full formula: «из великого князя села ис подклетного и Старотумова крестьянин Анфилог Иванов сын Констянтинова» ["from the grand prince's villages Podkletnoye and Starotumovo, the peasant Anfilog, Ivan's son, Konstyantinova"]. The social estate is named directly — peasant; Anfilog is a personal name, not a modern surname.
strings.Публикаторы датируют судную грамоту 1530: The editors date the court charter to the 1530s; it was drawn up under Grand Prince Vasily Ivanovich. Anfilog was an adult participant in an official inquest in the same decade in which Tver Onfilogovo first entered the scribal book of 1539/1540.
strings.Источник относит его к великокняжеским с: The source assigns him to the grand prince's villages of Podkletnoye and Starotumovo in Ryazan uyezd. He was not a peasant of the Olgov Monastery and is not named as an inhabitant of the disputed Ruposovo: he was summoned as one of the sovereign's people of the district able to give testimony on oath by kissing the cross.
strings.Как устроено полное именование: How the full designation is constructed
strings.«Иванов сын» прямо сообщает имя отца — И: «Иванов сын» ["Ivan's son"] directly gives the father's name — Ivan. The form «Констянтинова» in the published line may be yet another family designation or a trace of complex editing of the list; the alphabetical index of the publication normalises the man as Anpilog (Anfilog) Ivanov syn Konstantinova. A hereditary surname in the modern sense cannot be derived from this form.
strings.Его роль в деле о деревне: His role in the case of the village
strings.Обыщик Тимофей Аигустов выяснял, кто пос: The inquest officer Timofei Aigustov was establishing who had set up the village of Ruposovo, how many years it had existed and to whom the land belonged. Anfilog, together with other deti boyarskie, clergy and peasants, confirmed the old ownership of the Olgov Monastery. The final formula counts 43 people questioned in all.
strings.Почему это лучший образец крестьянина-эп: Why this is the best example of a peasant eponym
strings.Здесь совпали четыре обстоятельства: пол: Four circumstances coincide here: the full form of the name Anfilog, a directly stated peasant status, the era of the 1530s and a document specifically investigating the memory of who set up the village. No other namesake found combines these features. Therefore the find noticeably strengthens the version that the Tver Onfilog could also have been a peasant first settler or old resident.
strings.Что тот же обыск говорит об основании де: What the same inquest says about the founding of a village
strings.Свидетели отвечали именно на формулу «кт: The witnesses answered precisely the formula «кто ту деревню поставил» ["who set up that village"]. Some remembered seven years, others six, still others four, and named Karets Kurdumov with his son Fyodor. This is direct proof that in the 16th century the origin of a recent settlement was established through the testimony of neighbouring peasants and deti boyarskie, and that the expression «поставил деревню» ["set up the village"] was applied to specific people. For Onfilogovo such a line has not yet been found.
strings.Прямой пример названия по человеку в той: A direct example of a name derived from a person in the same charter
strings.О соседнем старом селище участники обыск: About a neighbouring old abandoned settlement the participants of the inquest said literally: «словет ... то селищо Митусово потому, что жил на том селище конюх Митус» ["that old settlement is called ... Mitusovo because the stableman Mitus lived on that settlement"]. In one sentence the document preserved the name of the eponym, his occupation and the explanation of the name. This is the closest example in genre of what a lost early line about Onfilogovo might have looked like: «потому, что жил ... Онфилог» ["because ... Onfilog lived"]. But Mitus lived in Ryazan uyezd and has no relation to the Tver village.
strings.Почему он не становится нашим Онфилогом: Why he does not become our Onfilog
strings.Документ относится к Рязанскому уезду и: The document relates to Ryazan uyezd and the dispute over Ruposovo. Between it and the Tver complex there is no common land, owner, relative or record of resettlement. The coincidence of name, time and social type makes him a model, and a candidate only if a new geographical bridge appears.
strings.РГАДА, ф. 1199, оп. 1, № 118, л. 200—220: RGADA, f. 1199, op. 1, No. 118, l. 200–220 verso; the name on l. 212. Publication: Monuments of the Ryazan Region (Pamyatniki Ryazanskogo kraya), No. 61, pp. 88–95. Open reprint of the full text: Materials for the History of the Kudayevs (Materialy k istorii Kudayevykh), Ryazan Region history portal.
strings.конюх, по имени которого прямо объяснено: stableman, by whose name the name of the old settlement Mitusovo is directly explained
strings.Человек более раннего времени, прямо наз: A man of an earlier time, directly named in a Ryazan court charter of the 1530s as the reason for the name of the old settlement Mitusovo. Not connected with Tver; added as a literal model of a proven eponym.
strings.Буквальное объяснение топонима: A literal explanation of the toponym
strings.Участники обыска не просто сопоставили п: The participants of the inquest did not simply compare similar words but gave a causal formula: the old settlement is called Mitusovo because the stableman Mitus lived there. Therefore his status as eponym is established by direct testimony of the source, not by a researcher's reconstruction.
strings.Что известно о человеке: What is known about the man
strings.Из строки надёжно известны бытовое имя М: From the line, the everyday name Mitus and the occupation — stableman — are reliably known. His patronymic, family and period of service are not named. Since by the 1530s his homestead was already an old abandoned settlement, Mitus himself belonged to an earlier generation.
strings.Формула показывает, какой документ завер: The formula shows what document would complete our search: independent old residents would have to name Onfilog and state directly that the settlement got its name because he lived there or set up a homestead there. The name Onfilogovo itself gives the same possessive model, but so far without a surviving "because" sentence.
strings.Почему Митус не кандидат: Why Mitus is not a candidate
strings.Митус связан с селищем на речке Грязской: Mitus is associated with an old settlement on the stream Gryazskaya in Ryazan uyezd. The charter contains no Tver, no Nikolskoye Svechino, no Yurlovs and no Khorvach volost. He serves as a model of the level of proof, not as a possible identity of the Tver eponym.
RGADA, f. 1199, op. 1, No. 118, l. 213 verso–214, according to the publication; Monuments of the Ryazan Region (Pamyatniki Ryazanskogo kraya), No. 61, pp. 88–95.
strings.один из двух людей, которых свидетели пр: one of the two people whom the witnesses directly named as having set up the disputed settlement
strings.Отец Фёдора Карцова. В рязанском обыске: Father of Fyodor Kartsov. In the Ryazan inquest the witnesses named father and son as the people who set up a recent settlement on disputed monastery land. Has no relation to Onfilogovo.
strings.Свидетели сказали, что Карец и его сын Ф: The witnesses said that Karets and his son Fyodor «ту деревню поставили» ["set up that village"]. This is a rare example of a 16th-century document linking the emergence of a settlement with specific named people, rather than merely listing owners or households.
strings.Карец прямо назван отцом Фёдора. В други: Karets is directly named as Fyodor's father. Elsewhere in the charter his brother Peshko Kurdumov acts alongside Karets, so the form Kurdumov belongs to the family circle. The full modern surname cannot be mechanically carried over to every generation, but the kinship of father and son is stated literally.
strings.Спорная сторона находки: The contested side of the find
strings.Карец с сыном поставили дворы не на бесс: Karets and his son built their households on land that was not indisputably free: the monastery's witnesses asserted that the plot had long belonged to Ruposovo and that the former peasants had been driven off. Consequently, a «основатель поселения» ["founder of a settlement"] does not always mean the lawful owner or the first person on that spot.
strings.Что это меняет в гипотезе об Онфилоге: What this changes in the hypothesis about Onfilog
strings.Онфилог мог быть не помещиком, а человек: Onfilog may have been not a landholder but a man who actually built a household or a small new clearing (pochinok). But the example of Karets is a warning: even if such an entry is found, the right to the land will have to be established separately, and the new settlement distinguished from an older abandoned village site.
strings.сын Карца, названный сооснователем спорн: son of Karets, named as co-founder of the contested settlement and defendant in the land case
strings.Фёдор Карцов сын Курдумов: Fyodor Kartsov syn Kurdumov (Fyodor, son of Karets, Kurdumov)
strings.Ответчик в споре Ольгова монастыря о зем: Defendant in the Olgov Monastery's dispute over the Ruposovo land. Witnesses connected him and his father Karets with the appearance of new households four to seven years before the inquest.
strings.Федор — личное имя; Карцов сын — прямое: Fyodor is the personal name; Kartsov syn is a direct reference to his father Karets; Kurdumov is a family name repeated in the circle of his father and uncle. The diminutive form Fedko is usual for 16th-century administrative language and does not denote a different person.
strings.Почему его называют поставившим деревню: Why he is said to have built the village
strings.Одна группа свидетелей помнила семь лет: One group of witnesses remembered seven years since Karets and Fyodor built the settlement; another, six; a third had known Fyodor there for four years. The discrepancy shows the living but imprecise memory of contemporaries about a very recent foundation.
strings.Суд различал три вопроса: кто поставил н: The court distinguished three questions: who built the new households, to whom the land had long belonged, and whether there existed another Ruposovo. This distinction is fundamental for Onfilogovo: the eponym, the actual first settler and the legal owner may have been different people.
strings.Почему это не готовая аналогия один к од: Why this is not a ready-made one-to-one analogy
strings.Фёдор пытался называть свой двор старым: Fyodor tried to call his household by the old name of Mitusovo, whereas the monastery considered the land part of the ancient Ruposovo. The source shows that a name could be used in the parties' land strategy. Therefore for the Tver Onfilogovo a single late owner is not enough: an early independent link between the name, the place and the neighbours is needed.
strings.РГАДА, ф. 1199, оп. 1, № 118, л. 200—220: RGADA, f. 1199, op. 1, No. 118, l. 200–220 verso; publication «Памятники Рязанского края» ["Monuments of the Ryazan Land"], No. 61, pp. 88–95.
strings.держатель центра и трёх частей бывшего в: holder of the centre and three parts of Stefanida's former estate
strings.Статья № 276 той же описи даёт Вериге Бу: Article No. 276 of the same inventory gives Veriga Bulbin the waste lands Nikolskoye Svechino, Sadykovo and Ishkovo. The three names repeat verbatim the centre and two villages of Stefanida's estate; this is one of the main geographical keys confirming the identity of the Anfilogovo that was found.
strings.Почему он важен, хотя не владел Анфилого: Why he matters although he did not hold Anfilogovo
strings.Верига Булбин удерживает географический: Veriga Bulbin holds the geographical key to the whole find. His article repeats three names at once from the 1539/1540 entry: Nikolskoye Svechino, Sadykovo and Ishkovo. Thanks to this, Mikita Starkov with Anfilogovo can confidently be placed not among random settlements of the same name but within Stefanida's disintegrated complex.
strings.Как читать имя Верига: How to read the name Veriga
strings.Верига здесь мужское личное имя или усто: Veriga here is a male personal name or a stable nickname-type name, not the word for a chain and not a female name. After the word «поместье» ["pomestye"] it stands in the genitive case: «Вериги». The nominative form for the card is Veriga.
strings.Булбина — родительная форма фамильного и: Bulbina is the genitive form of the family name Bulbin: whose pomestye? Veriga Bulbin's. The handwriting calls for caution with one consonant, so the literal form is kept separately and is not expanded with an invented patronymic. For the historical conclusion the unmistakably legible names of the three waste lands matter more.
strings.За Веригой перечислены пустоши Никольско: Listed under Veriga are the waste lands Nikolskoye, also called Svechino, Sadykovo and Ishkovo. These are the former village centre with the church of St Nicholas and two of Stefanida's six dependent villages. The formula shows that by the 17th century not only an outlying village but the very centre of the complex was considered vacant land.
strings.В статье описи «Никольское, Свечино тож»: In the inventory article «Никольское, Свечино тож» ["Nikolskoye, also called Svechino"] is a double name for one waste land: the church name Nikolskoye and the old name Svechino. This pattern is an exact parallel to «Анфилогово, Белоглазово тож» ["Anfilogovo, also called Beloglazovo"] under Mikita and helps read the word «тож» correctly as a marker of a second name.
strings.Что он говорит о распаде имения: What he tells us about the break-up of the estate
strings.В XVI веке Стефанида держала село и все: In the 16th century Stefanida held the village and all six hamlets in a single article. After 1634/1635 the centre with Sadykovo and Ishkovo was with Bulbin, Anfilogovo with Starkov, Voronino and Popovo with Yurlov. This is no longer a single holding but at least three separate pomestye shares.
strings.Чего запись о нём не доказывает: What the entry about him does not prove
strings.Она не сообщает, что Верига был родствен: It does not state that Veriga was a relative of Stefanida, bought land from Starkov or took part in the desertion of the villages. The brief inventory records the state of the holding, but not its transfer history. These connections can only be established from full articles and charters.
strings.Почему имя оставлено в досье: Why the name is kept in the dossier
strings.Задача раздела — объяснять не только воз: The task of the section is to explain not only the possible founder but also the people through whom the fate of the place is proved. Without Veriga Bulbin the coincidence of Anfilogovo could be taken for a namesake; with his triad Nikolskoye Svechino – Sadykovo – Ishkovo the geographical attribution becomes considerably stronger.
strings.позднейший Юрлов, державший Воронино и П: a later Yurlov who held Voronino and Popovo
strings.Статья № 310 Юрьевского стана называет п: Article No. 310 of the Yuryev stan names the pomestye of Semyon Yurlov with the waste lands Voronino and Popovo, two villages of Stefanida's former complex. He is the first later Yurlov found to be directly connected with part of this estate, but his kinship with Ivan and Stefanida has not yet been proved.
strings.Главный смысл находки: The main significance of the find
strings.Семён Юрлов показывает, что фамильное им: Semyon Yurlov shows that the family name Yurlov continues to appear next to the land of Stefanida's former complex about a century later. His pomestye lists Voronino and Popovo, two of the six villages of the 1539/1540 article. This is a real proprietary continuity of the family name and the territory, but not yet a proven biological pedigree.
strings.Как буквально записано имя: How the name is literally written
strings.После слова «поместье» стоит родительный: After the word «поместье» ["pomestye"] comes the genitive case: «Семена Юрлова». The modern nominative form is Semyon Yurlov. The patronymic is not given in the brief inventory; it must not be added on the basis of similarity with other Yurlovs.
strings.Какие земли соединяют его со Стефанидой: Which lands link him to Stefanida
strings.В статье № 310 среди семи пустошей стоят: In article No. 310, Voronino and Popovo stand among seven waste lands. In 1539/1540 the same names close the list of villages attached to Nikolskoye Svechino. The coincidence of two neighbouring elements within the same Yuryev section is more reliable than a single toponymic coincidence.
strings.Почему это не сын Ивана по умолчанию: Why he is not Ivan's son by default
strings.Между Иваном Юрловым до 1539 года и Семё: About a century lies between Ivan Yurlov before 1539 and Semyon after 1634/1635. Even if the land stayed within a kin circle, Semyon could have been a grandson, great-grandson, in-law, a member of another branch or a new holder with the same surname. The source gives no patronymic and no formula of inheritance.
strings.Ограничение гипотезы об Иване Большом: A limit on the hypothesis about Ivan Bolshoy
strings.А. В. Казаков установил, что Иван Тимофе: A. V. Kazakov established that Ivan Timofeyevich Yurlov Bolshoy left no male descendants in Lithuania. Therefore Semyon cannot be declared his direct descendant in the male line. Theoretically another branch of the Yurlovs, a Moscow family, a female line or a new land transfer are possible, but each version must be confirmed by a separate act.
strings.В 1539/1540 году Стефанида названа женск: In 1539/1540 Stefanida is named with the female form Yurlova through her husband Ivan. In the 17th century Semyon bears the male form Yurlov and holds two parts of the same old complex. This combination sets a concrete archival question: by which charter did Voronino and Popovo pass to Semyon, and is the previous owner named in it.
strings.Другие пустоши в его статье: Other waste lands in his article
strings.Кроме Воронина и Попова, опись перечисля: Besides Voronino and Popovo, the inventory lists Strechino, Miniforovo, Tyurchilovo, Belkovo and Portayevo. They may help localise the boundaries of the pomestye and find parallel entries, but for now they should not automatically be included in Stefanida's complex: these names are absent from her 16th-century article.
strings.Как он помогает искать основателя: How he helps the search for the founder
strings.Семён не является эпонимом Онфилогова, н: Semyon is not the eponym of Onfilogovo, but his holding article may preserve a reference to an earlier grant or a transfer between kin. If the full text traces Voronino and Popovo back to Ivan Yurlov, the documents of this chain will become the nearest place to search for an even older charter in which Onfilog may have been named.
strings.Высокая уверенность: имя Семён Юрлов и п: High confidence: the name Semyon Yurlov and the waste lands Voronino and Popovo are legible in the official inventory; they belong to the Yuryev section. Medium: these are fragments specifically of Stefanida's former complex, since the cluster of holdings matches. Low: any specific kinship of Semyon with Ivan or Stefanida.
strings.Вместе с Иваном Петровичем Заболоцким пр: Together with Ivan Petrovich Zabolotsky he carried out the sovereign's survey of Tver uyezd. This name refers to the compiler of the book, not to a resident or owner of Onfilogovo. The form «Михаил Иванов» ["Mikhail Ivanov"] in the language of the document means Mikhail, son of Ivan; the double name Usov-Tatishchev links him to a branch of the Tatishchevs, but by itself does not establish kinship with the persons in this entry.
strings.Форма «Михаил Иванов» означает Михаил, с: The form «Михаил Иванов» means Mikhail, son of Ivan; the modern rendering is Mikhail Ivanovich. Usov-Tatishchev is a double family name of a branch of the Tatishchevs, not a reference to two different people.
strings.В деловом языке XVI века патроним мог пе: In 16th-century administrative language a patronymic could be rendered by a possessive form: «Михаил Иванов» literally means "Mikhail, Ivan's son". Normalising it to "Ivanovich" is convenient for the modern reader, but the literal form of the document should be kept separately.
strings.Михаил — календарное имя древнееврейског: Mikhail is a calendar name of Hebrew origin; N. A. Petrovsky's dictionary gives its original meaning as the comparative question "who is like God?". The meaning of the name says nothing about this Mikhail's service; his identity is determined by the combination of name, patronymic and double family name.
strings.Форма Усов-Татищев уточняет ветвь внутри: The form Usov-Tatishchev specifies a branch within the wider Tatishchev family. It cannot be split into a scribe Usov and a scribe Tatishchev: one person acts in the article, Mikhail Ivanov Usov-Tatishchev.
strings.Он был вторым государевым писцом и работ: He was the second sovereign's scribe and worked together with Ivan Zabolotsky. His name relates to the creation of the book, not to the holding of Nikolskoye Svechino nor to the origin of the name Onfilogovo.
strings.Скреплял книгу до л. 179. Его скрепа удо: He countersigned the book up to l. 179. His countersignature certifies the preceding part of the manuscript, but the article about Onfilogovo comes later, on l. 183 verso–184. Therefore Semeika is important for the history of the creation of the archival complex but cannot be considered the scribe of the article or a person connected with the origin of the village.
strings.Семейка — обычная для эпохи уменьшительн: Semeika is a diminutive form of the name Semyon, usual for the period. A diak was not a village clerk but a chancery official who certified a state book with his countersignature.
strings.Почему уменьшительная форма официальна: Why the diminutive form is official
strings.Слова с уменьшительным суффиксом в докум: Words with a diminutive suffix in 16th-century documents did not necessarily express domestic affection. Forms such as Semeika could be an ordinary administrative way of recording the name of a person of a certain social standing. Therefore it must not be corrected to "Semyon" in a quotation, although it is useful to explain the link between the names.
strings.Семён — русская форма старого Симеон; сл: Semyon is the Russian form of the old Simeon; N. A. Petrovsky's dictionary connects it with a Hebrew root meaning "to listen, to hear". The family form Karpov is not Semyon's patronymic in this entry: the source gives the stable naming «Семейка Карпов» ["Semeika Karpov"].
strings.Дьяк последовательно писал части своей п: The diak wrote parts of his signature successively on the leaves or across their joins, certifying the integrity of the book. Such a countersignature helps attribute the manuscript and see the boundary of the officials' responsibility, but gives no information about the owners of the village.
strings.Его скрепа заканчивается на л. 179, тогд: His countersignature ends at l. 179, whereas Onfilogovo is recorded on l. 183 verso–184. Therefore he is important for the history of the manuscript as a whole, but the specific leaf under study was certified by Andrei Myasnov.
strings.должностное лицо, скреплявшее листы книг: official who countersigned the leaves of the book
strings.С л. 179 скреплял ту часть книги, где на: From l. 179 onward he countersigned the part of the book in which the article about Nikolskoye Svechino and Onfilogovo stands, on l. 183 verso–184. His name relates to the certification of the manuscript's authenticity. It does not denote an owner or resident of the village, but helps describe precisely the provenance of the leaf under study.
strings.Андрей Мяснов скреплял книгу начиная с л: Andrei Myasnov countersigned the book starting from l. 179. The article about Onfilogovo lies within precisely this part, on l. 183 verso–184, so his name relates to the certification of the authenticity of the leaves under study.
strings.Семейка Карпов удостоверял предшествующу: Semeika Karpov certified the preceding part of the book, while on the leaves with Nikolskoye Svechino Andrei Myasnov's countersignature is already in effect. Therefore, in a precise description of the provenance of the article under study, Myasnov's name is closer to it than the name of the first diak.
strings.Андрей — личное имя, Мяснов — родовое им: Andrei is the personal name, Myasnov the family name. The patronymic is not given in the available description, so the entry must not be expanded into a three-part modern full name. The mere resemblance of the surname to an ordinary word gives no grounds for inventing a profession or origin for his family.
strings.Дьяк и писец — разные роли: Diak and scribe are different roles
strings.Писцы Заболоцкий и Усов-Татищев проводил: The scribes Zabolotsky and Usov-Tatishchev carried out the land survey, whereas Myasnov certified the finished book. These are different stages in the creation of the source: survey and recording on the one hand, chancery checking and countersigning on the other.
strings.Скрепа не делает Андрея владельцем, жите: The countersignature does not make Andrei an owner, resident or founder of the village. It allows the administrative provenance of the entry to be traced and distinguishes an official from participants in the holding.
strings.реальный носитель исходного имени, восст: a real bearer of the original name, reconstructed from his sons' patronymics; not a participant in the 1539/1540 event
strings.Амфилохіевъ — повторяющееся отчество Дио: Amfilokhiev (Амфилохіевъ), the recurring patronymic of Diomid and Evgraf Strunkin
strings.Амфилохий, отец Диомида и Евграфа Струнк: Amfilokhy, father of Diomid and Evgraf Strunkin
strings.Отец Диомида и Евграфа Стрункиных из кос: Father of Diomid and Evgraf Strunkin of the Kostyurino circle, who lived in the late 18th – early 19th century. Added to prove the real use of the name and the transition of forms Amfilokhy – Onfilog – Anfilog; not documentarily connected with the 16th-century Tver eponym.
strings.Как человек найден без собственной строк: How a person was found without an entry of his own
strings.Два документированных мужчины независимо: Two documented men are independently named Diomid Amfilokhiev Strunkin and Evgraf Amfilokhiev Strunkin. The repetition of a rare patronymic and surname indicates a common father, or fathers of the same name, called Amfilokhy; Evgraf's repeated role as godfather to Diomid's children makes a common family the most likely.
strings.Почему это не только этимология: Why this is not only etymology
strings.Ранние московские записи называют тех же: Early Moscow entries call the same people Deomid Anfilogeyev and Efgraf Anfilogov/Anfilogiyev. The fuller parish-register forms reveal the omitted part: Anfilog is the popular rendering of the name of their father Amfilokhy, and Strunkin is the family name.
strings.Диомид родился около 1821 года, Евграф —: Diomid was born about 1821, Evgraf about 1833/1834. Amfilokhy belongs to the previous generation and must have lived in the late 18th – early 19th century. Exact dates require the revision tales of Kostyurino.
strings.Он не мог основать тверское Онфилогово,: He could not have founded the Tver Onfilogovo, which already existed in 1539/1540. The find is valuable for something else: for the first time a literal person shows, within a single family's material, how the church name Amfilokhy turned into the everyday Anfilog and into the patronymic forms Anfilogov/Anfilogiyev.
strings.Для его собственного двора нужно открыть: For his own household the revision tales of Kostyurino need to be opened. The nearest digital address has been officially confirmed: GAYaO (State Archive of Yaroslavl Oblast), f. 100, op. 7, d. 250, l. 476 — Kostyurino in the 1782 census revision. Viewing requires authorisation on the portal via ESIA.
strings.человек, у которого документирован перех: a person in whom the transition of forms Anfilogov – Anfilogiyev – Amfilokhiev Strunkin is documented
strings.Крестьянин деревни Костюрина Угличского: Peasant of the village of Kostyurino, Uglich uyezd, documented in Moscow in 1853, 1858 and 1864. On the proven data not a relative of the Tver eponym; his entries are a direct linguistic example of a name being formed from Amfilokhy.
strings.В 1853 году ему 19 лет и он Ефграф Анфил: In 1853 he is 19 years old and is Efgraf Anfilogov; in 1858 he is 25 and is Efgraf Anfilogiyev from Kostyurino; in the parish registers of 1858 and 1864 he is Evgraf Amfilokhiev Strunkin. The match of age, owner, uyezd, village and Moscow circle makes the identity highly probable.
strings.Что здесь фамилия, а что отчество: What is the surname here and what is the patronymic
strings.Полная форма показывает структуру: Евгра: The full form shows the structure: Evgraf is the personal name, Amfilokhiev the patronymic from Amfilokhy, Strunkin the family name. In abbreviated confession-register entries the patronymic took the place of the second name and was read as the surname Anfilogov.
